nodes.description: Administrator address of the SErc20Delegator; used as the access control gate for admin functions.
Address of the delegate implementation contract that all delegated calls are forwarded to.
Address of the underlying EIP-20 asset wrapped by this SToken.
Comptroller contract overseeing inter-sToken operations.
Pending administrator address awaiting acceptance of admin rights.
Interest rate model contract used to compute borrow/supply rates.
Constructs the delegator, sets admin to msg.sender, initializes storage via delegatecall and sets final admin.
Admin-only setter that updates the implementation address and optionally resigns/become the old implementation.
Internal helper performing callee.delegatecall(data) and reverting on failure.
Public helper that delegates execution to the current implementation contract.
View helper that staticcalls the self wrapper delegateToImplementation and decodes the returned bytes.
Payable fallback that forwards all calldata to the implementation via delegatecall and returns raw returndata.
Externally exposed mint that delegates to the implementation and decodes a uint result.
Externally exposed redeem that delegates to the implementation and decodes a uint result.
Externally exposed borrow that delegates to the implementation and decodes a uint result.
Externally exposed liquidation entrypoint that delegates to the implementation.
ERC-20 transfer that delegates to the implementation and decodes a bool result.
Collateral seizure entrypoint used during liquidation, delegated to the implementation.
Admin function beginning admin transfer; delegates to the implementation.
Admin function accepting admin rights; delegates to the implementation.
Caller-controlled address used for admin initialization and admin authorization checks.
Raw callee.delegatecall(data) executed inside delegateTo, forwarding execution to an arbitrary callee with this contract's storage.
implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in the payable fallback, forwarding all calldata to the mutable implementation.
New implementation address parameter of _setImplementation.
Boolean parameter controlling whether _resignImplementation is called on the old implementation.
Encoded bytes forwarded to _becomeImplementation on the new implementation.
Target contract address for the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
Raw calldata bytes passed into the delegatecall helper functions.
Boolean success flag returned by the delegatecall/staticcall.
Bytes buffer holding the returndata from the delegatecall/staticcall.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, giving the deployer uncontrolled administrative privileges during initialization.
_setImplementation enforces require(msg.sender == admin), gating implementation replacement on the caller identity.
_setImplementation writes the caller-supplied implementation address into the implementation state variable.
Constructor calls delegateTo to run initialize on the implementation before admin is finalized.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation to execute _resignImplementation and _becomeImplementation.
delegateToImplementation performs delegateTo(implementation, data) using the stored implementation address.
delegateToImplementation reads the implementation state variable as the delegatecall target.
delegateTo executes the raw callee.delegatecall(data) unsafe operation.
Fallback forwards arbitrary calldata to the mutable implementation via delegatecall, allowing external code to run with this contract's storage and re-enter.
Fallback delegatecall target is taken from the implementation state variable, which admin can change.
mint delegates execution to the implementation through delegateToImplementation.
redeem delegates execution to the implementation through delegateToImplementation.
borrow delegates execution to the implementation through delegateToImplementation.
liquidateBorrow delegates execution to the implementation through delegateToImplementation.
transfer delegates execution to the implementation through delegateToImplementation.
seize delegates execution to the implementation through delegateToImplementation.
_setPendingAdmin is an admin-privileged function that delegates execution to the implementation.
_acceptAdmin is an admin-privileged function that delegates execution to the implementation.
delegateToViewImplementation staticcalls the self wrapper delegateToImplementation.
The new implementation_ parameter flows into _setImplementation and becomes the delegatecall target.
The allowResign parameter controls the conditional _resignImplementation delegatecall path.
becomeImplementationData is forwarded into the _becomeImplementation delegatecall payload.
The callee parameter is the target of the raw delegatecall inside delegateTo.
The data parameter is the raw payload forwarded to the implementation via delegatecall.
The success local captures the delegatecall result and gates the assembly revert path.
The returnData local holds delegatecall returndata that is reverted or returned to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: The implementation_ parameter is only meaningful as the new delegatecall target assigned inside _setImplementation.
The allowResign flag conditionally drives the _resignImplementation delegatecall inside _setImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is encoded into the _becomeImplementation delegatecall payload issued by _setImplementation.
The callee parameter exists solely as the target address of the delegatecall performed by delegateTo.
Raw data bytes are only used as the payload forwarded by delegateToImplementation to the implementation.
The success local is the immediate result of the delegatecall and only drives the revert branch in delegateTo.
The returnData local holds the delegatecall output and is only consumed by the revert/return logic in delegateTo.
